blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Taguig City Prosecutor’s Office has junked the complaints filed by the Taguig City police against three students who were arrested in a lightning rally near the University of Makati last Nov. 13. Based on the copy of the resolution dated Thursday, Nov. 19, the dismissed complaints involved alarm and scandal under Article 155. The demonstrators were also nabbed for alleged resistance and disobedience to an agent of a person in authority, under Article 151 of the Revised Penal Code.
